title: Thiol-epoxy Click Chemistry: The Synthesis of Vicinal Amino Alcohols Containing 1,2,4-Triazole Ring
content: As examples of “Click Chemistry”, the reaction of 1-(oxiran-2-ylmethyl)piperidine with several 1,2,4-triazoles derivatives was studied. According to as a result, the reaction shows that the oxirane ring opens regiospecifically, according to Krasusky’s rule, without using a catalyst. The basic nitrogen present in 1-(oxiran-2-ylmethyl)piperidine has a catalytic (anchimer) effect.
